items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: I called them all. Jack Holt, Sam Adams, Francis Whitby, Arthur Williams, me, Pete Jones, Eddie Anderson who played bass, then Debo Mills who played the drums, and Charlie Toran on piano.

ctx.x: So he was playing long solos, too. We commented that he was the star of the band and he got a lot of solos and things -- he could take ten choruses on something.
Yeah! He got a lot of solos. Then we had an alto player there named... We called him Jack Holt; his name was Les Holt. He played a lot of solos. He was a good alto player. Very good.
